awards_draft#u3.detail: Verified online (AP 16 Apr 2026; reporting through Aug 2026, no 2026-27 change found): 65 games with 20+ min in 63 and 15-20 min allowed in two; governs MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA, All-Defensive; ROY, Sixth Man, All-Rookie exempt; Extraordinary Circumstances challenge granted Doncic (64 g) and Cunningham (63 g), denied Edwards. Added new input nba.eligibility_appeal_grant_model to awards_draft stage s1 (description rewritten to verified facts); patched measurement of nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger and nba.games_played_eligibility (input_patches/NBA_a.json). Clutch coverage left flagged as unconfirmed.

awards_draft#u5.detail: Pass 2: removed the leftover position-group text. Changes: awards_draft mechanism.summary now says positionless top five per conference plus a 16 US / 8 international minimum; the s6 distribution now names displacement within conference and nationality group; the nba.allstar_fan_vote_composite rationale is patched (input_patches/NBA_a.json); the awards_draft catalog mechanism is rewritten via archetype_patches/NBA_a.json, which also fixes the false 'positional ballot constraints shape All-NBA' (All-NBA is positionless). Pass-1 fixes stand: positionless starters and reserves, nba.allstar_nationality_quota.

awards_draft#u6.detail: Verified from NBA.com Hustle Award releases (2021-2026): winner chosen by formula over nine per-minute hustle categories (deflections, charges, screen assists, contested 2s and 3s, off/def loose balls, off/def box-outs); weights unpublished. Added nba.hustle_stat_index (fitted rank-ordered weights, qualification floor, projection) as new stage s9 'Formula-decided Hustle Award' in awards_draft with a new hustle-tracking required_data set. Teammate/Sportsmanship stay on the nominee model.

off_court_events#u4.detail: Verified: Board of Governors on 25 Mar 2026 approved exploring Las Vegas and Seattle (23 of 30 needed), final vote later, 2028-29 target, Memphis or Minnesota likely to move East. Added nba.expansion_realignment_joint_tree (expansion vote -> realignment and moving-team pmf -> Europe announcement on one Board calendar) to off_court_events stage s3 and required_data[3], plus a conditional interaction with nba.governance_approval_pipeline. NBA Europe's current status was not found online and stays a tree node, not a verified fact.

parlay_combo#u7.detail: The NHL catalog has no single title input; the Stanley Cup probability is composed from nhl.season_sim_distribution (seeds), nhl.bracket_path_difficulty (bracket) and nhl.series_context (series). Patched nba.cross_league_title_combo measurement to read those NHL ids by name with as-of alignment (both legs from the same nightly run, as-of = min timestamp); KXNBANHL rules text (both must win; early No on elimination) re-read.

player_availability#u2.detail: Defect not real as stated. Rules text and the Kalshi API (KXNBASTARTERS-26OCTMIN-*, finalized) show KXNBASTARTERS is a single-game contract: start the first 2026-27 regular-season game and be on the floor at opening tip, announced-but-not-starting = No. So a game-level starter mechanism is live, and the catalog label 'starting lineup / player availability' fits; KXNBARETURN/KXNBACOMPETE are the season-level ones. No game-by-game starter series is listed. Clarified stage s2 of the player_availability record to say this.

player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.detail: Inputs fixed, mapping not. nba.starter_bench_definition_ledger is now attached to player_points via archetype_patches/NBA_a.json (audit entry added) next to nba.team_bench_points_model, and record stage s7 models the team total. Verified reason to re-file (Kalshi API GET /series/KXNBABENCHPTS, 8 Nov 2026): contract_terms BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT.pdf, product_metadata scope 'Bench Points', settlement ESPN/NBA. That is a team-entity stat on the same terms family as KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS, which is filed in game_overtime_and_team_events, the archetype that already owns nba.starter_bench_definition_ledger. Requesting the orchestrator re-file KXNBABENCHPTS there; this gap stays open until series_assignment.json changes.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-2h-ot-split.detail: Re-read rules: KXNBA2H includes OT, KXNBA2HWINNER excludes it. Added new input nba.second_half_reg_ot_joint_margin (one simulated game gives M2H_reg = regulation 2H margin and M2H_ot = M2H_reg + OT margins drawn from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin only when regulation ends tied) to stage s6 of quarter_and_half_markets and required_data[0].

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-live-state.detail: Re-verified on the Kalshi API 8 Nov 2026: KXNBA2H markets for 9 Nov games close 12 Nov 03:00Z with early close 'after a winner is declared', so they trade in play. Added nba.live_period_state (score, period-start score, clock, on-court fives, team fouls/bonus, timeouts from cdn.nba.com liveData, quote-aligned timestamps) as new stage s7 'In-play conditioning' in quarter_and_half_markets with a live-capture required_data set.

season_futures_team#sf-tiebreak-and-divi.detail: Pass 2: detached nba.division_race_tiebreak_state from its only archetype (unreg counting specials) via archetype_patches; its audit there is DUPLICATE_OF:nba.tiebreak_ledger, and its label/mechanism/measurement define it as a view of nba.tiebreak_ledger inside nba.standings_sim. No archetype consumes it separately now. The structured catalog audit_flag is written only from input_audit files, which I do not own. Corrected the multi-team order in the nba.tiebreak_ledger patch to division leader, head-to-head, division record, conference record, own-conference playoff-eligible record, net points (NBA.com six-step list; no other-conference step). The re-entry rule after a team separates is unconfirmed: the patch computes both variants.

season_stat_markets#ss-ownership-overlap.detail: season_stat_markets already had stage s5 using nba.standings_sim, but the streak inputs were not defined on it. Patched nba.standings_sim measurement to be the one shared stored game-level season-path simulation read by season_futures_team and season_stat_markets, and nba.team_win_streak_hazard to be a view of those paths (exact DP kept as a check); nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model already simulates from nba.standings_sim.

series_and_cup#sc-archetype-mismatch.detail: Decision recorded in the series_and_cup record: Cup contracts stay in this archetype as the separate stage s5 (own inputs nba.cup_format, nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state, nba.cup_finals_pair_probability and Cup data set). The 30-point comeback and 40-point Finals blowout stay in stage s4, fed by play-by-play score paths via nba.playoff_max_deficit_comeback_rate. Stage texts updated; series_assignment.json unchanged (read-only).

series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.detail: Pass 2: removed the stale neutral-knockout text. Patched mechanism and rationale of nba.cup_format, and mechanism and rationale of nba.cup_finals_pair_probability: higher seed hosts the QF and SF, only the final is neutral at Hinkle, group games count in standings. Rewrote the series_and_cup catalog mechanism (archetype_patches). awards_draft stage s7 text fixed. Whys re-attached with corrected text for cup_format in awards_draft and season_futures_team; the latter wrongly said Cup games do not affect standings.

series_and_cup#sc-ownership-overlap.detail: Pass 2: wired consumers or scoped them honestly. nba.title_path is now attached to player_milestones (archetype_patches plus audit entry, already in stage s6); it was already attached to season_futures_team, series_and_cup, awards_draft, parlay_combo and the playoff-points archetype. nba.series_length_distribution is redefined (patch) as the per-series kernel that title_path evaluates inside each draw. The title_path measurement now says set-matchup consumers, such as series cumulative points and per-series length markets, use that kernel directly, not the bracket draws. The false claim that series_cumulative_points reads title_path is removed.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u10.detail: Partly fixed, not closed. Verified 2026 format: four trios (two current players plus one legend), seven spots in fixed order, 70 s, two rounds. It is now in the nba.shooting_stars_team_skill measurement and rationale and in record stage s7 text, and the stale 'team size, rounds unverified' wording is removed. The per-spot point values and the tie rule could not be verified: the league rules PDF and pr.nba.com are unreachable from here, and searches return only older or WNBA formats. So the input still withholds probabilities.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u8.detail: Not closed. Splitting all_star_weekend_events into contest, exhibition and MVP archetypes needs new archetype keys and a series re-filing in series_assignment.json, or a new blueprint in the catalog. Neither is writable through review records or input patches. Per-series input scoping (catalog_entry and contract.series_input_scope) still carries each series' inputs, so the input coverage is intact; only the archetype mapping is unresolved.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u9.detail: Pass 2: the fan component was wired to the wrong input (the January starter ballot). I removed it and added new input nba.asg_mvp_fan_vote_share, the 25% in-game MVP fan vote with the January ballot rank as a prior only. It sits in stage s8, required_data[2], catalog_entry.inputs and contract.series_input_scope['KXNBAALLSTARMVP'] of the all-star record, and is attached on integrate. The nba.asg_mvp_vote_model measurement is patched to 0.75 panel share + 0.25 nba.asg_mvp_fan_vote_share over whole-tournament totals (verified for 2026: Edwards, 10 of 14 panel votes).

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.detail: The orchestrator relabelled it. Pass 2 (archetype_patches/NBA_a.json): rewrote its mechanism to the union over playoff games of a 50+ single-game tail and detached the 8 stale inputs: milestone_rates, combo_covariance, avg_rounding_and_games_state, team_win_streak_hazard, undefeated_start_survival, division_race_tiebreak_state, cup_finals_pair_probability, garbage. Their audit entries are kept as IRRELEVANT/BENCHMARK_ONLY/DUPLICATE_OF. 23 inputs remain, matching the staged playoff-path, availability, minutes and tail inputs.
